annotations.title: Change a Snapchat ad squad budget

description: Change the budget on a Snapchat AD SQUAD. BUDGETS LIVE ON THE AD SQUAD, not on the campaign — a campaign-level ask is refused by name rather than silently patching nothing. NEEDS confirm:true, and without it NOTHING CHANGES: you get a sentence naming the ad squad AS READ FROM SNAPCHAT and the amount, which you must show the user first. State a plain amount in dailyBudget and Hermoso converts to micro-currency; never pass both units. The new budget is READ BACK — report what Snapchat stored, in both micro and real money, not what you sent.

adAccountId.description: Snapchat ad account id shared with this profile; omit when only one is shared

confirm.description: REQUIRED true — without it nothing changes and you get the sentence to show the user

dailyBudget.description: in the ad account’s own currency — minimum 5

dailyBudgetMicro.description: ONLY if already multiplied by 1,000,000; never alongside dailyBudget

level.description: adsquad — the only tier that holds a budget on Snapchat

lifetimeBudget.description: lifetime budget in the ad account's currency; an alternative to dailyBudget

lifetimeBudgetMicro.description: lifetime budget in micro-currency; only if already converted, never with lifetimeBudget

name: set_snapchat_ads_budget
